LanguageData.LP_PactPower.label: pact power
LanguageData.LP_PactPower.description: Warlock ability power multiplier: 0.5 + (the higher of Social and Intellectual level) / 20, plus adventurer Charisma modifier × 0.05 and (proficiency bonus - 2) × 0.02, +2% for each level the combined warlock-type class levels exceed 1 (up to +40%). A Fiend-patron warlock who also has an otherworldly pact (Nine Hells or Abyss patron) gets warlock abilities ×1.25.
